name: Gmail & Calendar
description: Read and search your Gmail, draft replies, and read and add Google Calendar events. Reading and drafting are automatic; sending a draft and creating an event (which may email invitations) ask you first.

tools.name: list_messages
tools.description: Search mail: sender, subject, date, snippet (up to 25)

tools.name: get_message
tools.description: Read one message's headers and text

tools.name: create_draft
tools.description: Create a draft or a draft reply (nothing is sent)

tools.name: list_events
tools.description: List calendar events in a time window (up to 50)

tools.name: create_event
tools.description: Create a calendar event; with attendees Google emails invitations (asks you)

secrets.name: GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID
secrets.description: OAuth client id (Desktop app) from Google Cloud

secrets.name: GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET
secrets.description: OAuth client secret of that client

secrets.name: GOOGLE_REFRESH_TOKEN
secrets.description: Refresh token granted once for gmail.readonly, gmail.compose and calendar.events

settings.name: GOOGLE_CALENDAR_ID
settings.description: Calendar the event tools use (an id such as you@example.com, or primary)
